calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-17-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Yvonne Lee.
Petitioner: Marybeth Tereszkiewcz, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Ayluonne Txai, was sworn and examined.
No appearance by the Minor's Father and Co-Petitioner: Robert Collins, but signed the Petition consenting to the Name Change,
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Ayluonne Txai Tereszkiewicz.
Decree signed in open court.
